issue.title: The group row at the bottom of property cards
issue.description: Day, week, and quarter cards and grouped record walk rails show a quiet group row (`« Q3 · W27 … week 8 of 14 ▮▮■▯ … 2027-Q1 · W01 »`) from the same resolver behind `[N` / `]N`; legacy dailies get a derived step row; every missing stop reads dashed `+` (creatable) or dotted and faint (ghost) across rail items, chips, and arms; the album card says `· walks by Section`; and a preview matrix plus the existing e2e suites prove it on athena.

record-rail landed in bob-plugins Ledger Tools 1.152.0 (merged on origin/master 63e2f64 after calendar-rail took 1.151.0; commit via this turn's finalizer). New 242va BobLedgerToolsRecordWalkGroupRailMixin: walk.groupRail from walkMode.links v7 (else navGroupsResolve), gated on a healthy walk over >=2 occupied groups (ungrouped/single-group/syncing/grouping_unavailable never ask the resolver and keep today's rail); 242u appends the kit group row in place of bob-record-walk-track (arms '« <group> · <head>' / '<group> · <head> »', ↺ on wraps, ghost heads dotted '· not in vault', centre choice label + 'k of n' + member ticks), count tooltip 'By <Field>, then title · wraps around'; 242v recordWalkFor attaches it and recordWalkOptions gains handlers.groupOpen (ghost = notice + album sync; modified click on exists = Markdown open; plain click re-reads the pane text, re-validates target/path/state, refuses with 'The group stop changed — try again' + repaint, else focuses the card's leaf and runs open-prev/next-group-link; no-Nav fallback opens via recordWalkOpen); 242k one line attaches it to the sheet model's walk; 242ia adds the group rail to recordSheetWalkSignature. Album pill: 241u walkBy/walkByLabel in model + signature, 241x appends '· walks by <Field>' span with tooltip on healthy folded lines only. CSS in its own 'Record walk group row (bob-cli-oj record-rail)' block after the group-row block. Docs: docs/record-card.md and docs/albums.md (both <3000 words). Verified: new scripts/test-ledger-tools-record-walk-group-rail.cjs 12/12 (registered in test:unit) + album-header 41/41 (new pill test); record-walk, record-sheet, nav-groups, group-row, intention group-rail suites green; npm run build:check green; full npm test on the merged tree 8220/8226 with only two wall-time flakes (frees-marks:481, keep-moving-marks:236) that pass in isolation (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP noted); docs:check fails only on base budget errors (nav-hotkeys reference 6247/6000, vault-format 6037/6000 = bob-cli-oc). Throwaway real-Obsidian render (light/dark x 375/900 + forced-colors) checked: group row replaces the track, narrow collapses to '« 🛑 … · 2/3 · 🏁 Conclusion »', ghost arm dotted; note for rail-proof: under forced-colors the kit's transparent 1px border makes exists group arms draw a solid box (kit-wide, not record-specific). bob plugins sync deployed 1.152.0; bob plugins list --no-pull shows bob-ledger-tools 1.152.0 synced.
